notablePrerequisites: You have at least one additional card in hand.
description:
Cast Beck by paying {G}{U}.
Activate Pegasus Refuge by paying {2} and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Pegasus creature token.
When the Pegasus enters the battlefield, Rite of Harmony triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pegasus, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
